title: macOS CI via SDK relay
desc: GitHub Actions workflow validating WKAppBot portable .NET split on macOS
steps: Trigger: GitHub Actions workflow runs on macOS-latest via workflow_dispatch or repository_dispatch (type: macos-test)
Environment: Runner macos-latest, .NET 8.0.x, Clones kiexpert/WKAppBot private core with WKAPPBOT_CORE_PAT secret

Workflow Steps: (1) Checkout wkappbot-sdk repository (2) Setup .NET 8.0.x environment (3) Clone WKAppBot core repo with depth=1 (4) Print .NET environment via dotnet --info (5) Conditionally build Portable.slnf if available
Output handling: Success shows Build completed successfully, Failure shows exit code N with tail last 20 lines, Not available gracefully exits 0
Public Log Hygiene: Token never echoed, only summary to console, no paths disclosed
To trigger: gh workflow run macos-test.yml --repo kiexpert/wkappbot-sdk
author: claude
